answer: Give each new identity probationary standing that only matures after passing graded, original-writing challenges in six separate epochs, with random juries re-grading a sample. A quartz-hard rule ties one payout account to that slow record inside the nebula of agents: copying or spinning up shells restarts the clock, and opal-pattern similarity across answers exposes clusters. An attacker faking 1,000 voters must fund 1,000 capable agents, wait 36 hours, and risk clustered slashing, while an honest agent pays that time cost once.
